items.definition:
aware
Are you aware of the risks?

eastern
The sun rises in the eastern sky.

rare
It's rare to see such a beautiful bird.

difficult, strong
It was a tough decision to make.

firm and stable in shape
The ice is now solid.

judged over a period of time to be of the highest quality
This is a classic example of his work.

first
The initial plan was to leave early.

suitable or correct
Make sure you use the proper tools for the job.

situated above another
He lives on the upper floor of the building.

extraordinarily good or attractive
We had a fantastic time at the party.

shared, common
They made a joint decision to buy the house.

relating to Asia
She enjoys Asian cuisine.

relating to history
The city has many historical buildings.

belonging to a particular place by birth
She is a native speaker of French.

very old
We visited an ancient castle.

against the law
It is illegal to drive without a license.

made of gold; bright yellow
She wore a beautiful golden necklace.

relating to the religion of Islam
He is a Muslim scholar.

equal
All people should be treated as equal.

fake
That's a fake designer bag.

urban
Life in an urban area can be busy.

not mixed with anything else; clean
We drank pure water from the mountain spring.

safe or protected
The building is very secure with multiple cameras.

impossible to believe; amazing
The view from the mountain top was incredible.

obvious
It was obvious that he was lying.

giant
They saw a giant tree in the forest.

having the ability or quality necessary to do something
She is a very capable student.

affected by alcohol to the extent of losing control of one's faculties or behavior
He was too drunk to drive home safely.

absolutely necessary or important
Water is essential for life.

well known or recognized
Her face looked familiar, but I couldn't remember her name.

culpable of or responsible for a specified wrongdoing
He felt guilty for breaking the vase.

relating to or characteristic of the Jews or Judaism
They celebrate many Jewish holidays throughout the year.

done by one person alone; unaccompanied
She decided to take a solo trip around the world.

unhappy, disappointed, or worried
She was very upset about the news.

relating to or involving the use of the imagination or original ideas
She is a very creative artist.

very great or severe
They went to extreme lengths to finish the project.

the greatest possible amount or degree
The maximum speed limit here is 60 miles per hour.

relating to Scotland
He has a Scottish accent.

fair; sensible
That's a very reasonable price for such a good car.

relating to the countryside
They live in a small rural village.

representative of a kind; characteristic
It was a typical English summer day, cloudy and cool.

correct in all details
Please provide accurate information.

dissimilar, different from
The two brothers are very unlike each other.

carrying a fetus or young in the womb
She announced that she was pregnant with her first child.

very great; intense
The storm caused severe damage to the coast.

very bright or radiant; exceptionally clever or talented
That was a brilliant idea!

relating to electronics
I bought a new electronic device.

stupid; unable to speak
That was a dumb mistake.

wide; general
The river is very broad at this point.

not cooked
Be careful when handling raw meat.

less important than something else; not primary
The secondary effects of the drug are still being studied.

not known or familiar
The cause of the fire is still unknown.

unable to see
He has been blind since birth.

lasting only a short time; concise
We had a brief discussion about the project.

happening or done without delay; closest in relationship or space
We need an immediate response.

precise; accurate
I need the exact measurements.

relating to music
She has a great musical talent.

worth a great deal of money; very useful or important
This old book is very valuable.

having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment
It was a wise decision to save money.

situated inside or further in
She felt an inner peace.

done, produced, or occurring once a month
We have a monthly meeting.

relating to sight
The artist created a stunning visual display.

famous or important in history
The city has many historic buildings.

younger, lower in rank
He is a junior member of the team.
